sloka: ईदृशा बुद्धि संपन्ना जितक्रोधा जितेइन्द्रियाः ।द्रष्टव्या वानरेइन्द्रेण दिष्ट्या दर्शनम् आगताः ॥४-४-२६॥
transliteration: īdṛśā buddhi saṁpannā jitakrodhā jiteindriyāḥ ।draṣṭavyā vānareindreṇa diṣṭyā darśanam āgatāḥ ॥4-4-26॥

translations.english: 'It is a matter of great fortune that you who have intelligence, control over your senses and conquered anger have come to see the lord of monkeys who needs instead, to approach you.
